annotations.title: I haue no wil in you.
annotations.text: Manie Prophets (as vve haue often noted) did foreshew the reiection of the Ievves, ◦ and vocation of the Gentils: but none more plainly then this here; by whom God expreſly ſayth: I haue no wil in you: and I vvil not receiue gift of your hand. The reaſon is alſo explicated in this chapter, becauſe God moſt peculiarly louing them, they were ſtil vngratful, and diſpiſed him, committing ſinnes vpon ſinnes And therfore in their place, he would bring in the Gentils: and that not anie one, or few nations, but al from the riſing of the ſunne, to the going downe therof, ſhould ſovvner or later come into his Church.

notes.text: Reiection of the Ievves and vocation of the Gentils.

annotations.title: In euerie place there is ſacrificing.
annotations.text: God not only changed, and multiplied his people, but alſo changed, and bettered his Sacrifice. [1] For in place of ſacrificing cattel, birdes, and other weake and poore creatures, [2] which were not able to purge ſinnes, and vvere alſo polluted oftentimes by the ſinnes of them that offered the ſame, God here promiſeth a moſt effectual, pure, & excellent daylie Sacrifice, to continew perpetually in al places of his Church, that can not be polluted. Which accordingly our Bleſſed Redemer and Sauiour inſtituted, of his owne bodie and bloud, in the formes of bread and vvine. As al ancient Fathers proue, [3] by this place amongſt others. So S. Iuſtinus Martyr teacheth, in dialogo cum Triphone. S. Cyprian. li 1. c. 18. aduerſus Iudæos: S. Damaſcen. li 4. c. 14 de fide Orthodoxa. S. Ierom, S. Theodoret, and S. Cyril in their commentaries vpon this place. S. Auguſtin li 18. c. 35. de ciuit. S. Chryſoſtom in Ps. 95. and Orat. 2. contra Iudæos. [4] shewing plainly, and vrging the Ievves, and al oppugners of this Catholique beleefe and doctrine, that this prophecie is no otherwiſe fulfilled, but in the daylie Sacrifice of the Church. For that here is prophecied an other Sacrifice, diſtinct and different from the Ievves ſacrifices: neither vvere ſacrifices offered in al the vvorld, neither could be ordinarily offered out of Ieruſalem. [5] But of this moſt ſacred Myſterie, and particularly that it is here prophecied, there is ſo much publiſhed by ancient and late writers, that more nedeth not to be here added.

notes.text: Al old sacrifices abolished, and the sacrifice of Christs bodie & bloud prophecied.
And reasons deduced from the scriptures.
